instruction: In the spreadsheet, find the highest sales value among all sales representatives across all months and highlight that cell with any background color.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum sales value and highlighting it. Verified with Python: maximum value is 783 at cell G7 (Naoma Moyer, June). Evaluator checks if cell G7 has background fill color applied (any color acceptable). Score breakdown: 0.3 for correct cell reference, 0.7 for highlighting applied.

Metric logic properly checks: (a) result cell matches expected cell G7 (0.3 points), (b) cell has background fill applied (0.7 points)

Expected value (cell G7) is correctly determined from actual data analysis as documented in metadata
